info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science

description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在訓練學生從事資訊專業領域中研究開發的能力，由問題的發掘與定義、解決方法的提出、實驗的設計及結果的歸納，以至研究成果的發表與論文的撰寫。期望學生在論文研究的訓練過程中，能培養自我學習的能力、與不同領域研究人員溝通的能力、團隊合作的精神以及資訊領域之工程倫理。
description.describe_eh: This course trains students on the capabilities to carry out the professional job of development and research in the field of information engineering: to identify and formulate computer engineering problems, to bring up their solutions, to design experiments and draw conclusions, to present research results, and to write thesis. This training would build up the students' capabilities to study on their own and to communicate with research people from other fields, their team work spirits, and their understanding of professional and ethical responsibilities.

targets.describe_ch: 分析研究的主題，並運用從課程、自我學習、以及相關文獻所收集的知識及經驗，以建立研究問題的基礎。
targets.describe_en: Analyze the research topic and build the research base by using the knowledge and experiences through courses, self-learning, and related articles.

targets.describe_ch: 經由定期的研究團對研討，培養比較分析不同見解與解決方案的能力，並培養與不同領域研究人員溝通的技巧及經驗。
targets.describe_en: By regularly discuss with research team to gain the capability of comparison/judgment of different solution strategies and opinions, and build up the skills of communications with researchers in different fields.

targets.describe_ch: 提出研究問題的解決方法或開發新的應用，設計實驗或實作軟硬體系統，以鑑別研究方法的可行性與效能。
targets.describe_en: Verify the feasibility of the solutions of research topics by proposing solutions, developing new applications, designing experiments, or implementing hardware/software systems

targets.describe_ch: 總結所獲致的研究成果，並以正確的寫作規範及格式撰寫專業科技論文，以及利用清晰的口語表述來發表之。
targets.describe_en: Conclude the research results using professional technical research thesis with correct writing regulations/formats and the clear oral presentations.

targets.describe_ch: 透過論文及成果發表，實際瞭解資訊安全、資訊倫理議題、以及著作權相關法規
